 SSC Napoli vs. Lazio Moneyline Insights 
 Napoli has compiled a 4-2-2 record when favored on the moneyline this season.
 This season Lazio has been an underdog four times, and won three of those games.
 When it has played as a moneyline favorite with odds of +129 or shorter, Napoli has gone 4-1-1 (66.7%).
 Lazio is undefeated in the three games this season when they’re the underdog by +189 or more on the moneyline.
